text:
noah: Heads-up: rolling session-cache-opt -> session-cache-v2. Feature flag session-cache-v2-ff will be toggled in us-east first. Change window 2h, canaries in a single AZ. Release doc: https://go/release/2026-03-session-cache :eyes:

deploy-bot: Kick-off acknowledged. Canary cr-6134 created. Initial step: 2% traffic to v2 in us-east-1 (AZ a). Dash: https://dash/redwood/canary/cr-6134

leah: Watch rules: if error budget burn >0.2%/min OR p95 latency > baseline +150ms -> kill-switch (set ff 0% immediately) and page.

pete: Fallback prepared: tag=v1-pin-2026-03-21. Rollback playbook: https://internal/rollbacks/session-cache-v1. Pin command ready: `/route-pin set default session-router v1 --tag v1-pin-2026-03-21`

toni: Rollout plan I'm applying now (regions will mirror after us-east):
```
feature_flag: session-cache-v2-ff
rollout:
  - t0: 2%
  - t+15m: 10%  # hold 20m
  - t+50m: 40%  # hold 30m (exclude AZ-level overrides)
  - manual: 100% (post manual sign-off)
triggers:
  error_rate_per_min: 0.2%
  p95_latency_ms: 150
  cpu_delta_percent: 30
```

qa-bot: Running smoke-suite now; will post quick-pass/fail in this thread.

deploy-bot: t+10m metrics: p50 +5ms, p95 +20ms, errors within baseline. Advancing to 10%.

ops-bot: Observed CPU rise on us-east-1a worker pool (worker-group session-wg-03) coincident with canary. Suggest AZ override rather than full rollback if isolated.

pete: I can push an AZ-level pin to route that AZ back to v1 temporarily: `/route override --az us-east-1a --service session-router --pin v1 --tag v1-pin-2026-03-21`.

noah: Do that. Pause global ramp until we see 25m stable metrics excluding that AZ. Keep the kill-switch ready.

leah: Agreed. If the CPU delta persists >20% for 30m we escalate and consider rollback.

deploy-bot: AZ override applied: us-east-1a pinned to v1. Canary metrics (excluding pinned AZ) stable at t+35m. Holding at 10% per plan.

qa-bot: Smoke summary: core auth/session flows OK. One intermittent 429 from rate-limiter observed (trace id f2c3) — non-blocking, logged to https://logs/redwood?q=f2c3

toni: Given QA green and metrics stable (excluding pinned AZ), moving to 40% now. Command: `/ff roll session-cache-v2-ff --region us-east --target 40 --hold 30m`

deploy-bot: Flag updated to 40% in us-east. Holdpoint active for 30m. Monitor: https://dash/redwood/canary/cr-6134/metrics

ops-bot: Noting AZ-specific memory pressure in us-east-1a was likely due to background compaction job scheduled earlier; that job was deferred. Removing the AZ pin once compaction finishes is fine.

pete: I'll keep the v1-pin available for immediate rollback and will hold permission to execute `/route-pin set default session-router v1 --tag v1-pin-2026-03-21` for 48h.

deploy-bot: At t+80m holdpoint passed, metrics healthy. Manual approval required to go to 100%.

noah: Manual approval granted. Final checks: business metrics, synthetics, and cost delta. Anyone see red?

qa-bot: Synthetics green, business KPIs steady. Cost delta within expected envelope.

leah: No red. Proceed to full region roll. Toni, execute final step. :white_check_mark:

toni: Executing `/ff roll session-cache-v2-ff --region us-east --target 100` now. Will apply same holdpoints in eu/apac as separate canaries.

deploy-bot: session-cache-v2-ff at 100% in us-east. Canary cr-6134 closed (success). Global rollout scheduled next hour to eu and apac with identical holdpoints. Release notes updated: https://go/release/2026-03-session-cache#done

noah: Nice job. Follow-ups: add AZ-override guidance to runbook, annotate rollback tag v1-pin-2026-03-21 for 48h, monitor mem/cpu for 24h.

leah: Thanks team. Closing thread; will open a short post-deploy check-in doc tomorrow.
